phases.name: Requirements
phases.purpose: Retrieve the real user stories from Confluence through the Atlassian MCP server and turn them into testable requirements.
external_inputs: Confluence page URL or search terms supplied by the human

outputs.description: Requirements derived from the retrieved Confluence user stories, with evidence references

validation_rules: all required sections present; no placeholders or secrets
every Evidence-ID refers to an audit-log entry recorded by the guard hook for an Atlassian/Confluence MCP call made after this phase started
every Confluence-URL appears in the result of a referenced MCP call
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Architecture
phases.purpose: Design the solution that satisfies the approved requirements.
validation_rules: all required sections present; no placeholders or secrets
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Design Review
phases.purpose: Independently critique the architecture against the requirements before planning.
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Planning
phases.purpose: Break the approved design into ordered, testable implementation tasks.

outputs.description: Implementation plan with test strategy and definition of done

validation_rules: all required sections present; no placeholders or secrets
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Implementation
phases.purpose: Implement the approved plan in todo/ with tests in tests/test_todo.py and report what changed.

outputs.description: Report of code changes, tests, and deviations from the plan

validation_rules: all required sections present; no placeholders or secrets
code writes are limited to write_globs (enforced by the guard hook)
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Review
phases.purpose: Review the implementation for correctness, security, and conformance to the plan.
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Verification
phases.purpose: Run the real test suite through 'orchestrator.py run-checks' and record evidence that requirements are met.
validation_rules: Evidence-ID refers to a passing 'checks.run' audit entry made after this phase started
the evidence's source digest equals the current source tree (code unchanged since the tests ran)
completion_conditions: a human approves the exact submitted content

phases.name: Pull Request
phases.purpose: Prepare the pull request, and create it through the GitHub MCP server only after a human authorizes it.
external_inputs: Repository, head branch, and base branch chosen by the human

outputs.description: Pull request title, description, authorization record, and created PR evidence

validation_rules: all required sections present; no placeholders or secrets
submit additionally requires PR-URL and PR-Evidence-ID referring to a create_pull_request MCP call recorded by the guard hook after the human authorization
completion_conditions: the PR was created through GitHub MCP
a human approves; merging remains human-only
